summary: This topic describes how to view the salary template (contract) currently assigned to a specific employee.
steps: Click on the employee's record to view their details.
Scroll down to the "Salary Template" section.
Click on "Salary Template" to view the details of the assigned contract.
business_rules: This view shows the active contract details.
important_notes: While a new contract can be added from this view, it is generally preferable to use "Assign Salary Template" under HRM for better calculation visibility.
questions: How can I check an employee's current salary contract?
Where do I find the details of an employee's assigned salary template?
